digest.component_or_area: E2 deterministic mutation benchmark and counting harness
propositions: Seeded-defect mutant corpus with five defect classes (absent capability, layer-cake split, consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge, unnecessary mechanism, untagged operational AC) was designed and built as deterministic WIP on branch calib/6982-e2, not landed on main.

Pure counting helpers (classify_pair, run_validity) and store-isolation mechanism (git clone --local isolation) were implemented and unit-tested offline, with run-validity guard capping INDETERMINATE at ≥0.20.

The ~100-run live LLM baseline batch over the mutant corpus is permanently rejected on cost and superseded by d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder on main, which accumulates detection/FP signal from production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost.
History-based baseline mining is dead due to stranded impact_model_version bump leaving only ~4 plan-v3 sidecars versus ~200 required.
Story was operator-approved for rescope and close on 2026-07-18; acceptance criteria were restricted to delivered deterministic WIP only.
